meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 渲染动画视频并生成配音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常做动画短视频，需要批量渲染并加配音。
copy.tagline_en: Render animated videos and generate voiceover
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly make animated short videos and need batch rendering with voiceover.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 命令帮你走完视频制作流程:创建项目、查找可用动画、检查错误、预览时间线,最后渲染出成品;也能诊断构建或渲染失败。支持本地、云端等渲染方式。
howto.when: 当你说要制作或渲染视频、检查视频项目,或诊断构建/渲染报错时触发。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 为我的视频创建新项目
say.note: Claude 会运行 init 搭建项目骨架。

say.text: 从动作库里找一个逐行揭示标题的效果
say.note: Claude 会搜索 catalog 并安装匹配的动画。

say.text: 检查我的项目,通过后渲染成高清视频

howto.what_en: Claude uses HyperFrames CLI commands for video production: scaffold projects, search catalog for animations, lint/check, preview, and render files. It also diagnoses build/render failures and supports local, HeyGen cloud, Lambda, and Cloud Run rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to produce or render a video, inspect a HyperFrames project, or diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.text: Use HyperFrames to create a new project for my video.
say_en.note: Claude runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Find a motion that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Claude searches the catalog and installs a match.

say_en.text: Check my project, then render it in high quality.
say_en.note: Claude runs check, preview, and render.
